turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hello! Please share your order number (SC- followed by four digits), the email address you used to place the order, and what you’d like to discuss about your claim.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision to close your damage claim. Your reference is H-1.

input.summary: Customer (patrick.okonkwo@example.com) disputes the closure of their existing damage claim for SC-3072. They report that staff said the pale patches were part of the drawing. Please review the prior decision and follow up with the customer.
